narrative.scqa_md:
SITUATION
VestGen Wealth Partners is a $6.67B AUM (Feb 28, 2026) [E-081] RIA aggregator founded December 2024, serving 9,453 mass-affluent clients across 35 states with an average balance of $367K [E-009]. In 16 months, VestGen doubled its regulatory AUM through 12+ practice acquisitions and the launch of 5 service lines [E-092, E-075, E-077]. Tom Woods (CLO/CCO, Hightower $150B, E-086), Ferian Nickelson (COO+CTO, BNY Pershing X, E-091), and 2 additional Hightower alumni arrived with institutional-grade discipline. VestGen already operates Salesforce Financial Services Cloud [E-098], a Snowflake+Azure data platform [E-099], and Zocks AI meeting notes [E-098].

COMPLICATION
Despite a technology-leading P4 score (2.68 vs peer median 2.38, +0.30), VestGen trails peers in P1 Strategy (2.40 vs 3.00, −0.60) and P2 Client Experience (2.06 vs 2.62, −0.56). The FinCEN August 2024 final rule [E-088] requires a complete BSA/AML program by January 1, 2028 — VestGen has no publicly disclosed RIA-side AML program. Privacy Policy March 31, 2026 [E-097] delivers manual-only opt-out, creating active non-compliance in 12 GPC-mandate states across VestGen's 35-state footprint [E-104, E-110]. The 13+ vendor stack with mixed API/ETL/SFTP patterns [E-090, E-098] creates per-acquisition integration debt.

Overall DMA score of 2.42 places VestGen 0.18 points below the peer median of 2.60, with Innovation (1.96, −1.04) and Advisor Experience (1.98, −1.02) as the two widest capability gaps. QUESTION
How can VestGen scale from $6.67B to $20B+ AUM through industrialized M&A integration — while closing compliance and client-experience maturity gaps — by leveraging its existing Salesforce FSC org and Snowflake platform before the January 2028 FinCEN deadline and April 2028 CCPA cybersecurity audit obligation? ANSWER
A three-phase Salesforce platform expansion — Activate (FSC optimization + Agentforce), Comply (Industries Compliance Cloud + AML 360 + Privacy Center + Shield), Scale (Data Cloud + Snowflake Zero Copy + MuleSoft + Industries Wealth Cloud) — advances VestGen from 2.42 to projected level 3 maturity across all four pillars, directly addressing three hard regulatory deadlines and the M&A integration industrialization imperative that underpins VestGen's $20B+ growth thesis.
